reconfigure.title: Move Znacht to another engine
reconfigure.description: Entities, history and the sidebar panel follow the new address.

hassio_confirm.title: Znacht add-on found
hassio_confirm.description: Set up Znacht with the {addon} add-on? The Znacht app is the add-on's own entry in the sidebar.

user.title: Set up Znacht
user.description: Znacht plans your week's dinners, fills your shopping lists and never orders or pays.

menu_options.addon: Run Znacht here in Home Assistant (recommended)
menu_options.manual: I already run the Znacht engine on another machine

addon.title: Your accounts
addon.description: Znacht signs in to these to plan and to fill your lists. Everything stays on this Home Assistant. {details}

data_description.cookidoo_email: Recipes and My Week on your Thermomix. Leave empty to try Znacht with sample recipes.
data_description.cookidoo_password: Used once to sign in; Znacht keeps a token, not the password.
data_description.migros_email: Your Migros Online account, for the two shopping lists. Leave empty for a sample shop.
data_description.migros_password: Used to sign in and when Migros asks to sign in again.
data_description.migros_totp_secret: Only if your Migros account uses an authenticator app: the setup key, not the 6-digit code.
data_description.anthropic_api_key: Optional. Claude plans more varied weeks and reads the pantry from a photo. Without a key, the built-in planner is used.
data_description.ha_notify: Told when a plan is ready to approve, when it was sent, and when Znacht needs a hand. Leave empty for no notifications.

error.cookidoo_failed: Cookidoo did not accept this. Check the email and password.
error.migros_failed: Migros did not accept this. Check the email and password (and the two-factor secret).
error.anthropic_failed: Claude did not accept this key.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Znacht now talks to the new engine.
abort.addon_failed: The Znacht add-on could not be set up: {error}

progress.install: Installing and starting the Znacht add-on. The first time, Home Assistant builds it, which can take a few minutes.

init.title: Your accounts and phone
init.description: Change the accounts Znacht uses and the phone it notifies. Leave a password empty to keep the current one; clear an email to use sample data for it. {details}
